content.title: Xcel Energy rolls out $60 billion capital spending plan
content.summary: The utility is planning 7.5 MW of renewable generation, 3 MW of gas generation, 1.9 MW of energy storage, 1,500 miles of high-voltage transmission and $5 billion for wildfire mitigation.

thumbnail.caption: An American flag is shown affixed to a burned truck in a neighborhood decimated by the Marshall Fire on Jan. 2, 2022, in Louisville, Colorado. Officials reported that 991 homes were destroyed, making it the most destructive wildfire in Colorado history.
